subject: Venus Shield
object: speaking with the big tree in the Alive Forest
text: Speaking with the big tree in the Alive Forest before getting the key means the Venus Shield can no longer be obtained.

evidence.quote: If you don't do this before speaking with the big tree in the Alive Forest, the story progression will prevent you from getting that key and you will be unable to get the Venus Shield.

subject: Venus Key
object: locked chest in the Focus Tower
text: Spencer in Aquaria gives the Venus Key, which opens the locked chest in the Focus Tower holding the Venus Shield.

evidence.quote: After beating the Ice Golem, you need to speak with Spencer in Spencer's place in Aquaria to get the Venus Key to open the locked chest in the Focus Tower for the Venus Shield.

subject: Cure
text: Cure overflow damages the Dark King, and Phoebe's high Magic makes her Cure overflow twice into healing.

evidence.quote: Due to how healing scales in Mystic Quest, the MC’s Cure overflows into dealing damage to the Dark King, and due to Phoebe’s high Magic stat, her Cure actually overflows twice to turn it back into healing.

subject: Cure
text: The main character's Cure spell can deal 5-figure damage to the Dark King.

subject: Dark King
text: The glitch makes the Dark King the easiest Final Fantasy final boss, excluding cutscene bosses.

evidence.quote: It’s a very funny glitch that makes this boss the easiest FF final boss ever (excluding cutscene bosses where you can’t lose)
